content: Duty performed with absolute detachment leaves behind no residue of sorrow or regret.
author: Sanskrit Subhashitas
sourceWork: Nishkama Karma (निष्ककाम कर्म) — Classical Philosophy of Action
explanation: Regret only clings to actions that were performed for selfish calculation, vain display, or hidden agendas. When you perform your duty cleanly—simply because it is right, fair, and necessary—your soul walks away completely weightless and free.
practicalInsight: Fulfill your primary responsibility today purely as a clean offering of service, free of any expectation of praise.
reflectionPrompt: What hidden strings or selfish expectations are you attaching to the duties you perform for others?
